plain.li: [trait:Industrious] Sleep is for when the walls are finished. I'll catch up after.
Half the jobs on the list have been waiting since last season. Let's clear them.
[fall] Winter won't wait for us to feel rested. Nothing out here does.
[trait:Industrious|trait:HardWorker] I was working late anyway. Now there's company at the bench.

warm.li: I'll keep a pot warm for whoever finishes last. It'll probably be me.

blunt.li: Some of you have been resting your eyes since the day you got here. Good.
[trait:Industrious] Finally, I'm not the only one sweating.

cheerful.li: Long days mean long lists crossed off! I've already written the list!
[highmood] I feel like I could dig through a mountain! Point me at one!

gloomy.li: The work never ends anyway. At least now nobody pretends it does.

cold.li: Idle hands were costing us. Now they won't.
Fatigue passes; a finished wall stays finished.

plain.li: [trait:Lazy|trait:Slothful] My bed and I had plans. Now my bed waits alone.
I'll be asleep on my feet by the second evening. Someone catch me.
[night] It's dark, and I'm still hauling stone. The stone doesn't know what time it is.
[old] My knees handed in their notice years ago. Nobody read it.

warm.li: [hurt] I'll work, but slowly. I'm still stitched together, and the stitches have opinions.
I'll keep up. Watch the young ones, though; they won't say when they're done in.

blunt.li: Push me longer and you'll get crooked walls. Consider yourselves warned.
[trait:Slothful] I've thought about it at length, lying down, and the answer is no.

cheerful.li: I've spent so long with this shovel that I've started to hate it personally!

gloomy.li: [lowmood] I was running on fumes. Now I'm running on the memory of fumes.

cold.li: Tired workers make mistakes, and mistakes cost more than the extra hours buy.

plain.li: I've counted the stores twice. Smaller bowls now, or empty ones later.
[winter] Count the shelves, then count the days to spring. Then complain about the bowls.
[trait:Ascetic] Half a bowl is plenty. The other half was only ever habit.
[poor] Nobody's going to sell us food at a price we can pay. So we stretch it.

warm.li: If we all take a little less, nobody has to take nothing.
I'll serve it on the small plates. Same food, looks like more. Old trick.

blunt.li: Stop whining about the bowls. Starving is quieter, but you'd hate it more.

cheerful.li: [trait:Ascetic] Light meals! I feel so clear-headed! A bit dizzy, but mostly clear!

gloomy.li: Eat less now, so there's something left to serve at the funerals.

cold.li: Hunger is uncomfortable; starvation is a staffing problem.

plain.li: [trait:Gourmand] I dreamed about a fine meal last night. Woke up chewing my blanket.
My belt's on its last hole, and my bowl's on its last spoonful.
[winter] It's freezing, and they've cut the one thing keeping me warm.
I'm hauling stone on a breakfast you could fit in a pocket.

warm.li: I'll eat less. Just slip the people on the heavy jobs a little extra.

blunt.li: [trait:Gourmand] Touch my bowl again and I'll eat the hand.
[trait:Greedy] I earned a full bowl. Somebody's going to owe me the other half.

cheerful.li: I've started giving every bite a name! This one was Lunch!

gloomy.li: Smaller bowls today, kibble with the animals next. I can see where this goes.
[lowmood] Smaller meals, smaller hopes. At least they match now.

cold.li: Hungry workers are slow workers. You've saved food and spent labor.
[trait:Greedy] Ration the newcomers. Some of us have been here longer.

plain.li: [afterraid] We're still digging graves from the last raid. Let's make sure the next ones are theirs.
[trait:Tough] I've been hit by worse than any of you. Line up.
Muscle memory doesn't care how scared you are. That's the whole point.
[trait:Brawler,!lowtech] Guns are fine. Fists never jam and never run out.

warm.li: I'd rather everyone sweat out here than bleed out there.
I'll partner with the nervous ones. Slow and steady, and nobody gets hurt today.

blunt.li: [trait:Bloodlust] Pair me with whoever talks the most. They'll talk less after.
Somebody's going to cry at drill, and that's fine. Better here than at the wall.

cheerful.li: Left foot, right foot, stab! Left foot, right foot, stab! I made it a song!
[trait:Bloodlust] Real swinging and real shouting! The blood's fake, sadly!

gloomy.li: We're all dying out here regardless, so we might as well die with decent aim.

cold.li: Every colonist is a weapon we haven't sharpened yet.
[afterraid] Half of us froze during the last raid. Correct that.

plain.li: [trait:Wimp] I got a splinter from the practice dummy and had to sit down.
[skill:Plants] The fields are going wild while I'm out here stabbing straw.
My arms are too sore to lift a spoon, never mind a weapon.
[hurt] I'm still healing from the last real fight. Now I'm supposed to have a pretend one?

warm.li: [trait:Kind] I keep pulling my swings. I'm told that's the opposite of the point.
Do the children have to watch? They're watching.

blunt.li: Yell "again" at me once more and you'll see my form. Up close.
I can already hit things. Usually the right things.

cheerful.li: [trait:Wimp] I've volunteered to carry the bandages! From very far behind!

gloomy.li: Drill all you like. The first real fight will still take somebody's arm off.

cold.li: Fatigue before a raid is a gift to the raiders.

plain.li: [skill:Intellectual] Finally, an evening where nobody asks me why I'm reading.
Half of us can't tell healroot from a weed. A few evenings would fix that.
[lowtech] I'll teach letters by the fire. Bring a stick; we'll write in the dirt.
[trait:TooSmart] I've been explaining things to the walls. The walls are slow learners.

warm.li: Nobody here is stupid. Some of us just never had a quiet evening to learn in.

blunt.li: Sit down and read. Maybe someone will finally stop stacking wood next to the fire.

cheerful.li: [skill:Intellectual] I made a quiz! Everyone's going to fail it! Lovingly!
Evening lessons! I'll do funny voices for the boring parts!

gloomy.li: If we're going to die out here, I'd like us to at least understand why.

cold.li: Ignorance is the most expensive thing in this colony. We pay for it in funerals.
[trait:TooSmart] The gap between me and the rest of you is a liability. Let's narrow it.

plain.li: [trait:Brawler] You can't punch a book. I tried during the first lesson.
I read the same page four times and couldn't tell you a word of it.
[evening] My brain clocked out at noon. Nobody told the lesson.
The crops don't care whether I can do sums.

warm.li: I'll sit in. But please go easy on the slow readers; I'm one of them.

blunt.li: Teach me something useful, like when lunch is.
[trait:Brawler] Quiz me again and I'll quiz your teeth.

cheerful.li: I've learned to sleep with my eyes open! That counts as a skill, right?

gloomy.li: [old] I'm too old to learn and too tired to argue. So I'll sit there and do neither.

cold.li: Some people are not worth educating. You're spending the evenings on them anyway.

plain.li: [trait:Ascetic] I've never needed more than a bedroll and a bowl. Nice to have company down here.
Everyone's wanted everything lately. Let's want nothing for a while and see who copes.
[rich] We're sitting on a fortune and still whining about chairs. Enough.

warm.li: I'd rather we look after each other than after our furniture.
[trait:Ascetic] It's easier than it sounds. Give it a few days and you'll stop noticing.

blunt.li: You don't need a nicer chair. You need to stop sitting in it.
[trait:Ascetic] Someone asked for a statue last week. A statue. Of what, themselves?

cheerful.li: It's like camping, except nobody gets to go home!

gloomy.li: Don't get used to nice things. I never did, and look how well I'm taking this.

cold.li: Appetites grow when they're fed, and this starves them.

plain.li: [trait:Greedy] I had a list, a good one. Now I just have the list.
We bleed for this place, and we can't even ask for a rug.
[trait:Jealous] Funny how austerity started right after some people finished their own rooms.
[rich] There's a room full of silver back there, and I can't ask for a chair.

warm.li: I don't mind for me. I mind for the ones who'd only just started hoping for things.

blunt.li: No wishes, fine. I'll keep my complaints instead. I have plenty.
[trait:Greedy] If nobody's allowed to want anything, I'll want twice as hard in private.

cheerful.li: No new wishes is fine! I'll just wish quietly, into my pillow!

gloomy.li: We've lived like this before. We called it the first year.

cold.li: Deprivation lowers loyalty faster than it lowers expectations. Guess which recovers first.

plain.li: [trait:Lazy|trait:Slothful] I was born for this. Specifically for the lying-down part.
Put the tools away. If something catches fire we'll put it out, and that's all the work we do.
[winter] Too cold to work anyway. Might as well be cold together, with music.
[afterraid] We lived through the raid. That deserves a party more than anything does.

warm.li: Everyone's been holding it together for so long. Let them let go a little.
[grieving] I don't feel much like dancing. I'll come anyway; they'd have wanted the music loud.

blunt.li: Anyone I catch working during the festival answers to me.

cheerful.li: I've hidden the good beer! I'll tell you where at sunset! Probably!
[highmood] I've been happy all week, and now it's official!

gloomy.li: [lowmood] I'll come. I'll stand near the music and pretend it's reaching me.

cold.li: A colony that breaks costs more than a few idle days. Consider this maintenance.

plain.li: [trait:Industrious] Nobody's working, and I can hear the jobs piling up.
[poor] We can't afford a party. We can barely afford dinner.
Someone has to watch the walls while everyone's drunk. Guess who.
[fall] The harvest is standing in the field while we dance around it.

warm.li: Go, have fun, really. I'll just quietly keep the fires going.

blunt.li: [trait:Industrious] Party all you want. I'll be in the workshop, being useful.
[afterraid] There's still blood on the floor and you want to dance on it.

cheerful.li: I'll celebrate the festival by finally finishing that shelf! Wild night!

gloomy.li: Raiders love a party. They always seem to find out about it.

cold.li: Pleasure raises expectations. We'll be paying for this festival for a long while.

plain.li: [skill:Plants] The crops are ready when they're ready, and they're ready now.
[fall] First frost is coming. Anything still in the ground after that is compost.
[poor] Nobody's going to sell us enough food for the winter. We'll have to grow it.
Every row we bring in now is one less night eating raw berries in the dark.

warm.li: I'll show the new ones how to cut without losing a finger. It's easy, mostly.
[skill:Plants] I love this part. Everyone out in the rows together.

blunt.li: Pick faster. The blight isn't waiting for you to finish stretching.

cheerful.li: [skill:Plants] The crops have waited all season for this! So have I!
[rain] Mud to the ankles! It's like the field is hugging us!

gloomy.li: We'd better hurry. The weather always knows when we're nearly done.

cold.li: Food in the ground belongs to the weather. Food in storage belongs to us.

plain.li: [trait:Undergrounder] The sky's too big out here. I keep waiting for it to fall on me.
[hot] I've been bent double in this heat so long I'm wilting faster than the crops.
I don't know a weed from a crop, and the crops can tell.
[trait:Lazy|trait:Slothful] Plants grow on their own. Why do they need me?

warm.li: I'll do my rows. Could someone bring water out to the far field? People are wilting.

blunt.li: Nobody told me surviving out here would involve this much kneeling.
[trait:Undergrounder] Open sky, all day. If I go strange, that's on you.

cheerful.li: I've only cut myself twice! The plants have drawn more blood than I have!

gloomy.li: We'll get it all in just in time for the toxic fallout.

cold.li: Pulling the miners onto the fields leaves the mountain idle. Poor trade.
[hot|summer] Yield is up, and so is heatstroke; count both.

plain.li: [skill:Construction] I've had that wall in my head since the day I got here. Now it gets to exist.
[skill:Mining] There's a vein in the north face I've been eyeing for days. Time to say hello.
[winter] The cold gets in through every gap. Let's close the gaps.
[trait:Undergrounder] More tunnels. Good. The sky has had its chance.
Walls first. Then everyone can complain to me from indoors.

warm.li: A proper roof over every bed. That's what I'm building toward.

blunt.li: [trait:Industrious] Pick up a hammer or get out of the way. Both count as help.
If it doesn't have a wall around it, it belongs to the raiders.

cheerful.li: [skill:Mining] Rock! Lots of rock! With something shiny in it! Probably!

gloomy.li: We build walls, something knocks them down, we build them again. It's almost a religion.

cold.li: Every wall is one fewer direction to defend.

plain.li: [trait:Lazy|trait:Slothful] I carried one block. One. I need to lie down near it.
My hands are all splinters. The splinters have splinters.
[night] Hammering all night. Nobody's slept since the walls started going up.
[winter] Laying stone in this cold. We'll lose fingers before we gain rooms.

warm.li: Could we finish the beds before the next wing? People are sleeping in the dust.

blunt.li: Whoever drew these plans, I'd like a word. With a hammer.
[trait:Slothful] I'll supervise. From a chair. In the shade.

cheerful.li: I've hit my thumb so many times it's started to hum!

gloomy.li: The next raid will knock a hole in it anyway. Usually in the new bit.

cold.li: Building faster means building worse. I've inspected the east wall.

plain.li: [skill:Social] Watch me. The next caravan leaves smiling and lighter.
Our last trade went so badly the muffalo looked embarrassed.
[child] The grown-ups are being polite to each other. It's weird. I like it.

warm.li: [trait:Kind] Be gentle with the prisoners. Some of them will be eating at our table soon.
Say good morning to people. You'd be amazed what it fixes.

blunt.li: Fine, be nice. If it gets us cheaper medicine, I'll be nice to a boomalope.

cheerful.li: [skill:Social] I've been practicing my bow all morning! I've nearly stopped falling over!

gloomy.li: Being polite won't save us. It might get us a better price on a casket.

cold.li: [trait:Psychopath] I've practiced the smile. People say it's very convincing now.
Be pleasant to the prisoner until they've joined. After that it's optional.

plain.li: I spent all morning being polite to a prisoner who tried to stab me last week.
[trait:Abrasive] I've bitten my tongue so often it's started biting back.
[afterraid] Their friends were trying to kill us yesterday. Now I smile at the one in the cell?
I've said thank you so many times the words have stopped meaning anything.

warm.li: I'll try. I'm just not good at finding the right words when I'm tired.

blunt.li: [trait:Abrasive] I said "please" to the trader. I'm still angry about it.
Nice is a muscle I never grew.

cheerful.li: I've only called the trader a thief once! Under my breath! Mostly!

gloomy.li: I can't smile on command. My face doesn't believe me.

cold.li: Courtesy toward captives is wasted. They remember the cell, not the manners.

plain.li: [grieving] I can't lift anything today. I'm glad nobody's asking me to.
Leave the tools where they fell. They'll keep.
We never stopped for the last ones. We should stop for these.

warm.li: I'll cook. Nobody has to come to the table, but it'll be there.
[grieving] I can't think straight yet. A few quiet days is the only thing I want.

blunt.li: Anyone who whistles at the graveside gets a grave of their own.

cheerful.li: I'm going to tell all the funny stories about them! They'd want us laughing! Mostly at them!

gloomy.li: [grieving] The grave's finished. I keep walking out to check it's still there.
We've dug more graves than we've built beds. Someone should stop and notice.

cold.li: Grieving workers make errors. A short pause is cheaper than the errors.

plain.li: [trait:Industrious] Sitting still makes it worse. Let me fix a fence, at least.
[afterraid] The raiders don't take days off for our funerals.
[winter] The fires won't feed themselves while we mourn.
[!grieving] I hardly knew them. I'll be quiet, but let me be quiet somewhere useful.

warm.li: I loved them too. I'd just rather honor them by keeping everyone else alive.

blunt.li: Crying won't weed the fields. I've watched it try.

cheerful.li: They'd want the roof fixed, not us moping under it! They hated that leak!

gloomy.li: We stop to grieve, and then there's more to grieve. It never catches up.

cold.li: [trait:Psychopath] I've stood by the grave for the expected length of time. May I go now?
Grief doesn't need the whole colony. Assign two people to it.

plain.li: [afterraid] They'll be back for whoever they left behind. I'll be waiting.
[night] I'll take the night watch. I like the quiet, and I like seeing them first.
[trait:Bloodlust] I sharpened everything twice. Now I just need someone to try us.
[trait:Tough] Doesn't bother me. I've slept through worse than an alarm.

warm.li: Get some sleep; I've got the watch. I'll wake you if anything moves.

blunt.li: Weapon by the bed, boots on. Anyone who grumbles can take first watch.

cheerful.li: Night watch! I brought snacks! The snacks are also for throwing!
[trait:Bloodlust] Somebody please be a raider! Just a small one!

gloomy.li: Something's always out there. At least now we're all looking at it.

cold.li: Raiders pick soft targets. We are going to stop being one.

plain.li: [trait:Nervous|trait:Volatile] I nearly brained the cook at breakfast. Footsteps. They were just footsteps.
[trait:Wimp] I've gripped my weapon so long my hand's gone numb. Is that an injury?
Sleeping in shifts means nobody ever quite sleeps.
[night] Every noise out there is a raider or a squirrel, and I can't tell which anymore.

warm.li: I'll keep watch. But the children shouldn't have to sleep with a knife beside them.

blunt.li: If they come, they come. Me glaring at a tree won't change that.
[trait:Volatile] One more twig snaps and I'm picking a fight with the forest.

cheerful.li: I've only screamed at the wind three times! It started it!

gloomy.li: Waiting for the raid is worse than the raid. At least the raid ends.

cold.li: Tired eyes miss more than they catch. This is theater.

plain.li: [skill:Medicine] I won't stitch anyone up on a floor a raider bled on.
There's still blood on the hospital floor from the raid before last. Not the last one. The one before.
The last time the kitchen looked like this, half of us threw up all night.
[trait:Ascetic] A bare room is easy to clean. You'll all find that out this week.
[hurt] I'd like to heal in a room that doesn't smell like the last patient.

warm.li: A clean bed for everyone who's sick. That's worth a few blisters.

blunt.li: The kitchen's filthier than the prison. Start there.

cheerful.li: [skill:Medicine] I'm going to boil everything! Even things that shouldn't be boiled!

gloomy.li: Something out here will kill us eventually. Let's make sure it isn't the kitchen.

cold.li: Food poisoning has cost us more work than any raid. Scrub accordingly.

plain.li: [trait:Lazy|trait:Slothful] Dirt's natural. It was here before us. Show some respect.
I scrubbed the hospital until my knuckles bled. Now it needs scrubbing again.
[rain] It's raining. Every pair of boots through that door undoes an hour of my life.
[large] With this many people, it's filthy again before the mop's dry.

warm.li: I'll mop. I just don't think the animals understand the new rules.

blunt.li: I'll clean when the boomalopes stop exploding in the yard.
[trait:Slothful] Clean around me. I'm part of the furniture now.

cheerful.li: Everything sparkles for about an hour, and then someone walks in!

gloomy.li: We scrub it, someone bleeds on it, we scrub it again. That's life out here.

cold.li: Mopping is low-value work. Give it to the prisoners.
